svg.aria-label: Tangent as the limit of secants
svg.title: Tangent as the limit of secants
svg.desc: A parabola with point P fixed at x=2. Four dashed orange secant lines fan out from P toward four progressively-closer second points (Δx = 2.5, 1.5, 0.8, 0.3), each more opaque than the last. The final solid green line is the tangent at P. A side panel shows the limit definition f'(2) = lim(Δx→0) [f(2+Δx) - f(2)] / Δx = 1.6.
svg.text: Tangent as the Limit of Secants — Δx → 0
As the second point slides toward P, the secants pivot toward the tangent.
